dishes.name: Quenelles de brochet
dishes.desc: Light poached pike dumplings in a creamy Nantua crayfish sauce. A signature of Lyon's bouchons.

dishes.name: Salade lyonnaise
dishes.desc: Curly endive with bacon, croutons and a poached egg in a hot vinegar dressing. The standard bouchon starter.

dishes.name: Tablier de sapeur
dishes.desc: Breaded and fried tripe, served with gribiche sauce. A bouchon favourite named after the firefighter's apron.

dishes.name: Rosette de Lyon
dishes.desc: A dry-cured pork sausage sliced thin, the city's classic charcuterie. Found in bouchons and the Halles.

dishes.name: Saucisson brioché
dishes.desc: Hot Lyon sausage baked inside soft brioche dough, sold in bakeries and charcuteries and eaten on the go.

dishes.name: Tarte aux pralines
dishes.desc: A tart covered in a pink sugared almond filling, the city's most recognisable dessert. Sold in bakeries across Lyon.

dishes.name: Cervelle de canut
dishes.desc: Fresh cheese whipped with herbs, shallots, garlic and white wine, spread on bread. A Lyon bouchon starter named after the silk workers.
